name: Scrape Careers Jobs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    #- cron: "0 7 * * *" # Daily 07:00 UTC

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: "true"

jobs:
  scrape:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Install Chromium
        run: python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Increase /dev/shm size
        run: sudo mount -t tmpfs -o size=512m tmpfs /dev/shm

      - name: Debug Chromium
        run: |
          python - <<'EOF'
          import os, subprocess, tempfile, time
          from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

          with sync_playwright() as p:
              exe = p.chromium.executable_path
              print(f"Chromium: {exe}")
              print(f"Exists:   {os.path.exists(exe)}")

              ud = tempfile.mkdtemp()
              proc = subprocess.Popen(
                  [exe, "--headless=new", "--no-sandbox", "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
                   "--disable-gpu", "--no-zygote", f"--user-data-dir={ud}",
                   "--remote-debugging-port=9222"],
                  stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
              )
              time.sleep(4)
              rc = proc.poll()
              out, err = proc.communicate(timeout=2) if rc is not None else (b"", b"")
              print(f"Exit code after 4s: {rc}")
              print(f"STDOUT: {out.decode()[:500]}")
              print(f"STDERR: {err.decode()[:1000]}")
          EOF

      - name: Run scraper
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          CAREERS_URL: ${{ secrets.CAREERS_URL }}
        run: python scrape_jobs.py

      - name: Commit updated jobs.json
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add data/jobs.json

          git diff --staged --quiet || (
            git commit -m "Update Product & Tech jobs"
            git push
          )
